description: Ministry of Lands - Amendment to the notice of Appointment of Acquiring Officer Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1988/39 of 14.10.2016
reasoning: The gazette content is a correction notice specifically related to the Land Acquisition Act. It amends the description of Divisional Secretary's Divisions for land acquisition purposes in Kurunegala, Kegalle and Kandy districts. This falls squarely under land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4). The content does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
